description:
Restores signal on the repo root before the next round of feature work.

## What

- Drop `docs-legacy/` (60KB, deprecated since Sep 2025; explicitly redirected callers to the live docs site and all content has been migrated)
- Refresh `readme.md`:
  - Add missing `apps/moo-dang` (WASM web shell) and `@sparkle/test-utils` packages
  - Correct prerequisites (pnpm >=10, the repo pins `packageManager: pnpm@10.33.4`)
  - Fix stale `./docs/project-guide.md` and `./docs/best-practices-for-sparkle-development.md` references (those files were inside `docs-legacy/`)
  - Update the architecture tree to reflect the actual `apps/` vs `packages/` split and the live package set
  - Point Resources to <https://sparkle.mrbro.dev> and the existing `.github/copilot-instructions.md`

## Why

The README and the deprecated `docs-legacy/` directory had drifted ~7 months out of date. The audit, the docs migration, and the moo-dang/test-utils packages all landed without README updates. New contributors and agents land on a README that misses half the surface area.

## Verification

- `pnpm check` clean
- No live code or workflow files reference `docs-legacy/` (only `.specstory/history/` historic Cursor logs)
- Live docs site is the canonical surface

## Related

- Closes #57 (Uplift sparkle — all three checklist items effectively complete)
- Diagnosis posted on #1604 (Astro 6 + Starlight 0.36 incompatibility; needs grouped Starlight >=0.39 upgrade)
